[[Lucasfilm Story Group]] executive [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed that live-action productions treat [[rank insignia plaque]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] by two eras: pre&ndash;[[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star I]] [[Battle of Yavin|destruction]] and post. The pre-destruction era utilizes the "single row" format for live-action media including ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' per {{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1533187590140006401|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-06-04|quote=@peacemakervitus There's basically two eras for Imperial badges - pre-Death Star destruction and post. So Andor and Kenobi follow the Rogue One 'single row' model.}}. Due to this, this individual's rank insignia plaque is consistent with its respective rank insignia and branch in the live-action production chart [[:File:Imperial Forces Rank Chart - Rogue One.png|here]], and as such must be that [[military rank]] and in that branch.
